title: Hackers are stealing Claude tokens from subscribers | TechCrunch
summary: After investigating, Anthropic told De Swardt it found the culprit: A compromised Claude session key was used to mint unauthorized Claude Code OAuth tokens. De Swardt’s Claude account was reinstated after about two weeks.
